dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open case: Coarse Menger Conjecture for c=2
dossier_meta.statement_text: It is unknown whether Conjecture 1.1 holds when $c = 2$: for all integers $k \geq 1$ there exists $\ell > 0$ such that for every graph $G$ and $S, T \subseteq V(G)$, either there are $k$ paths between $S, T$ pairwise at distance at least $2$, or there is a set $X \subseteq V(G)$ with $|X| \leq k-1$ such that every $S$-$T$ path contains a vertex within distance $\ell$ of some member of $X$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors note that the case $c = 3$ is of special interest because a positive result for $c = 3$ would imply one for all $c \geq 3$ (via taking the $c$-th power of $G$). They explicitly remark that 'the conjecture remains open when $c = 2$, and we have nothing to say about that case in this paper.'
